heading: Merry Christmas
design: Soft blended snowy edges and warm lights, reduced Santa and left sleigh/cottage. No garlands or rigid rails.

prompts.base: Redesign this Christmas photobooth PNG overlay. The user REJECTS the wall-picture-frame look. REMOVE ALL rectangular rails, metallic picture-frame outlines, burgundy vertical bars, rigid corner brackets, antique gold filigree. NO GARLANDS, greenery or foliage. Create a magical seamless CHRISTMAS PHOTO OVERLAY, soft photographic montage edge treatment that BLENDS into guest photo. Thin irregular wisps of powder snow/frost with sparse tiny warm golden light specks and subtle crystalline snowflakes at extreme outer edges, progressively feathering to fully transparent center. This is not a solid border: airy, organic, luminous, contemporary professional holiday editorial photography. Edge decoration occupies only 2-3% width along sides, top very minimal 3%, bottom snowbank 5%. Art extends completely OFF all canvas edges with no exposed outer margin and NO parallel vertical lines. Keep large genuinely transparent photo opening. Lower right a beautifully photorealistic, friendly real Santa in red velvet/fur, holding warmly glowing lantern; waist-up Santa roughly bottom 22% height and rightmost 17% width, grounded in soft snow that bleeds off bottom and right canvas. Lower left a small beautiful red sleigh, wrapped gifts, tiny warm-lit snowy cottage, blended into same low snowbank, bottom 12% height. Detailed realistic materials and photographic depth, elegant snow-white / warm gold / Christmas red accents. At absolute bottom center, small natural ivory fabric ribbon nestled in snow (not a hard plaque), clearly reads EXACTLY 'Merry Christmas' in elegant deep cranberry calligraphic lettering on ONE LINE. Ribbon shallow max 5% canvas height, around 38% width, lower edge flush to bottom canvas. No other text. No gray/black fill or painted checkerboard. Preserve REAL transparency. No entire background scenery, no giant bokeh blotches obscuring photo. Composition should feel like Santa and snowy festive objects are gently emerging at edges of the guest photo, NOT photo enclosed in a wooden/metal frame. Preserve orientation.
prompts.santaReduction: Targeted refinement of this transparent Christmas photobooth overlay. KEEP the same soft blended snow / luminous snowflake edge treatment, actual transparent photo opening, same overall orientation and lettering 'Merry Christmas' bottom center, and no rigid rails or garlands. The Santa is too large and consumes too much guest-photo space. SCALE DOWN Santa AND his lantern AND adjacent gifts to 65 percent of their present linear size, retaining realistic proportions and same detailed appearance, anchoring their bottom/right position to the extreme bottom right corner. This must create substantially more TRANSPARENT SPACE above Santa and to his left. Santa top must be no higher than 80 percent down the image: Santa occupies only the bottom 20% of total canvas height. Santa group must occupy no more than rightmost 16% canvas width. Keep Santa readable and photorealistic. Also slightly reduce left sleigh/cottage cluster (to 80% current scale) for a balanced low corner treatment; keep bottom snowbank shallow. Preserve soft irregular edge blending all the way to actual canvas edges, no visible margin/side gap. Keep the Merry Christmas ribbon low, close to bottom, one line, same spelling. No opaque new background, preserve genuine alpha. Maintain all other design choices. IMPORTANT actual smaller Santa, not merely cropped.
prompts.leftReduction: Targeted correction ONLY to bottom LEFT corner of this transparent Christmas photobooth overlay. Santa on RIGHT is now the correct smaller size: preserve Santa and right corner EXACTLY, do not enlarge or alter him. REDUCE the ENTIRE LEFT cluster (sleigh, cottage, gifts, lantern, miniature trees, baubles) to 60% of its present linear size, tuck it tightly into extreme bottom LEFT corner, maintain its realistic proportions/detail. Its top should align approximately with Santa's top, or slightly lower. Reclaim the space above and inward from left cluster as GENUINE TRANSPARENT PHOTO OPENING with delicate feathered snow edges. Avoid a tall tree above house. Keep the snowbank LOW, no increase in border thickness. Preserve all other pixels/design as closely as possible: thin organic softly blended crystalline snow/light edges touching canvas edges, no rails, no frame lines, no garlands; same Merry Christmas fabric ribbon at bottom center with exact legible wording, same photo opening, same aspect ratio and alpha. A clear large transparent central photo area is critical. Only change needed is a SMALLER lower-left arrangement balanced to the already smaller Santa on the right.
prompts.alphaRepair: BACKGROUND REMOVAL / ALPHA REPAIR ONLY. This is a photobooth OVERLAY, not a background. Preserve all visible snowflake edge artwork, gold tiny lights, small Santa right, small sleigh/cottage left, and exact 'Merry Christmas' ribbon artwork. REMOVE EVERY black, brown, gray or gold HAZE/VIGNETTE filling the large central opening. That ENTIRE inner photo opening must be literally EMPTY TRANSPARENT, alpha 0, not semitransparent tint. Transparent area should extend between edge snowflakes without a broad fading dark layer. Preserve actual snowflakes and decorative pixels with their natural antialiased alpha edges. Center 75% width x 65% height must be fully alpha zero. No painted black, white, gray, colored background or checkerboard. Genuine transparent cutout PNG. No compositional or scale changes. Remove only the background haze so an underlying guest photo is entirely unaltered. This alpha repair is mandatory: fully transparent center pixel, no residual opacity.

notes: Separate orientation compositions. Generated alpha preserved. Print resampling permits alpha <= 1/255 in central guest area. Legacy halloween-haunt filenames retained. Other six optional frame styles unchanged.
